description: A request body whose card number a matcher-only plugin's field-level generator fills, through janus-plugin-bridge's generate-field: the pact records a Visa number and generates a Mastercard one, and the provider recognises only a Mastercard number, so a verifier that sent the recorded value instead gets a 404
source: staged plan S5.2g; ADR 0113 decision 3; pact-plugins' creditcard plugin's generator, on a request the credit card example's provider would store
